name: Integrated Robot Palletizing Solution
summary: A more powerful integrated palletizing solution, including master-slave pallet stacking, automatic slip sheet placement, scanning, and other special functions.
contentHtml:
The Integrated Robot Palletizing Solution is a full-featured palletizing system developed by TXAM for high-end customers.

Working Principle

Based on standard palletizing functions, it integrates master-slave pallet stacking, automatic slip sheet placement, and scanning to automate the entire post-production logistics process.

Technical Advantages

  • Complete functionality covering the entire post-production logistics process
  • Master-slave pallet stacking function for more application scenarios
  • Automatic slip sheet placement reduces manual intervention
  • Scanning function enables traceable logistics information
